flagged.evidence: The proof says, “conversely position r' of a degree-2n-k element of the string is the image of r=r'-(n-k) with k=t_α+2r≥0,” but does not establish that r≥0. From the target position bound r'≤n−t_α and degree equation 2n−k=t_α+2r', one gets t_α≤k, hence r=(k−t_α)/2≥0. This short bound closes the surjectivity step.
